notes.notes:
Hi Tetherheads! We just popped out a new build of the game for some quality-of-life improvements, plus some fun VO.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Reduced memory need per frame to improve performance and eliminate hitching after hours of gameplay
[*] Added voice acting
[*] Fixed bugs introduced by some code refactoring
[*] Added kiosk/attract mode
[*] Removed issue with tether force dependence on framerate
[*] Enabled vsync
[/list]

notes.title: Online Multiplayer and Match Point
notes.notes:
Hey Tetherheads!

We've got some cool news. A lot of people have requested online multiplayer in Match Point. We're a two-man team with day jobs, so network code was a bit beyond the original scope of what we could accomplish for this title. But we're keeping that priority in mind for our next game!

In the meantime, we've got a really cool solution for Match Point. It's [url=https://parsecgaming.com/]Parsec[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734197/db39a8058c3e7709e454d3863522204ff73359a3.png[/img]

Parsec is kind of like a Steam Link over the Internet, or your own personal Playstation Now. You set up the client and invite friends to join local multiplayer games. Your screen is streamed to them, and their controller inputs are streamed back to you. It's super seamless and hella baller. We were blown away by its quality.

[h1]How to play Match Point online with Parsec[/h1]
[list]
[*] Visit [url=http://parsecgaming.com]http://parsecgaming.com[/url] and download their client.
[*] Open it and sign up for an account. Get your friends to too!
[*] Click "Add A Computer" to set your own computer up for streaming. You can control which programs people can see and join.
[*] Or, join a friend's computer by adding their Parsec username, and request to Co-Play.
[*] When you start the game, friends can drop in like they're right there!
[/list]

Visit the [url=https://ui.parsecgaming.com/parties/communities/47]Match Point Parsec Community[/url] to join or start a public "Party" and play with anyone! You may also be able to grab some opponents in the [url=https://jlly.co/discord]JCM Discord[/url].

notes.title: Host Tournaments with the Match Point Bracket
notes.notes:
Hey, Tetherheads! Along with Match Point, we built a single-elimination tournament bracket website that you can use to run your own events. [url=https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.10156289374101919&type=1&l=f3b90ea6fd]We used it at our launch party.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734197/a5778203fcdbb273c363040006753d6dde5a8aa8.jpg[/img]

[url=https://jollycrouton.com/matchpoint/bracket]Go to the Match Point bracket[/url]

You can build teams, automatically assign byes, reorder participants mid-tourney, save competitions for later, and even stream them to anyone with the link (or to another computer hooked up to a projector!)

It's free. :) Enjoy!

Oh, and thanks to everyone who picked up the game as part of the 2018 Yogscast Jingle Jam! Thanks to you, over $3 million was raised for charity. Holla!
